messages:
Maya (Growth): Hey team — heads up for the benchmark launch next Tue. We need a compact asset bundle for organic + paid socials, the blog header, and the webinar slide intro. High priority: an animated stat card (loop 2-3s), a static long-form blog header (2560x512), a slide-safe diagram that explains the routing (how Redwood falls back between model variants), and a one-page PDF leave-behind for webinar attendees. Can someone own creation + brand sanity check? Need first drafts in 48 hrs.

Carlos (Design): I can own. Quick ask: what are the exact stat copy strings and any approved imagery? Also prefer to build components in Figma auto-layout so the PMM can swap numbers later.

Priya (PMM): Stat copy: "2.5x median throughput improvement", "-38% token cost", "99.9% observed availability". Blog header headline: "Benchmark: Serving LLMs at production scale". Webinar deck intro line: "How we measure cost and latency in real workloads". Imagery: please use abstract gradient backgrounds or the Redwood infrastructure illustrations; avoid literal GPUs photos.

Evan (Brand): Guidelines: use the refreshed accent palette (gradient A->B), font stack Inter + Source Serif for headings, and follow new logo spacing. For PDF, include accessibility-friendly color contrast and provide alt-text/description. No drop shadows on stat panels. I'll do a final brand pass.

Carlos (Design): Plan: I'll produce
- animated stat card: 1080x1080 MP4 + GIF fallback (3s loop, 24fps)
- blog header: 2560x512 PNG and SVG (text outlined)
- slide diagram: 1920x1080 editable slide (also SVG)
- webinar leave-behind: A4 @300dpi PDF with a short bulleted summary and CTA.
Export presets: PNG (2x), SVG optimized, MP4 H.264 baseline. Naming: `benchmark_asset_<type>_<variant>_v1.<ext>`.

ops-bot: Routing check requested. Please confirm lead flow and SFDC queue mapping.

Priya (PMM): Lead routing: webinar signups -> SFDC campaign 'benchmark_launch_q3', assign to queue 'Growth Webinar Leads'. For paid social link tracking use params: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_q3&utm_medium=social&utm_source=org_social. Also set form hidden_field=campaign:benchmark_launch_q3.

Sam (Sales Ops): Confirmed. I'll add the queue and ensure Pardot mapping. I'll also configure a Slack notify to #sales-inbound with payload `campaign: benchmark_launch_q3`. Staging webhook test scheduled for tomorrow.

Carlos (Design): Noted. Uploading Figma file shortly. One question: should the animated stat card include the model names or keep generic?

Priya (PMM): Keep stat cards model-agnostic on the main socials; for technical blog we can include model names in caption. Also prepare two caption lengths for each asset (short: one-liner; long: 2-3 sentences). I'll paste copy in Figma comments.

Evan (Brand): brand-bot: scanned Figma export rules. Found one frame with low-contrast text on gradient; flagged. Carlos, please adjust to WCAG AA. Also include alt text snippets in the export manifest.

Carlos (Design): Will fix contrast and add an export.json with alt texts and suggested social captions. ETA: first drafts in 36 hours, final exports in 60 hours.

Maya (Growth): Great, please tag me when drafts are up. If brand-bot clears and ops test passes, we'll schedule organic posts + launch email for next Tue. Thanks all.

Priya (PMM): Also request: make a simplified black-and-white version of the one-pager for print. That helps events.

Carlos (Design): Will include B/W printable variant in the PDF bundle.

ops-bot: Staging webhook test completed successfully.

Sam (Sales Ops): All set on SFDC side. I'll monitor inbound and report daily lead counts during the first week.

Evan (Brand): I'll do a final pass once Carlos drops the files. Please follow the naming and spacing rules strictly.

Maya (Growth): Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround :rocket:
